edges.label: contradicts
edges.reason: The NEW occurrence states there were 'two most-voted candidates' (figure 2), while the EXISTING occurrence states there were 'three of the top vote-getters' (figure 3) in a context that seems to be defining the record-setting group. Since they provide different counts for the record-setting candidates in the same election, they are incompatible.

changes.sentence: On 2026-10-06, UPI reported “Two social media influencers and a transgender woman emerged as three of the top vote-getters in Brazil's Chamber of Deputies elections, setting records as voters also strengthened the congressional forces aligned with presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro.”; on the same day, UPI reported “Far-right influencers Nikolas Ferreira, 30, and Lucas Pavanato, 28, who have millions of social media followers, became the two most-voted candidates Sunday for the Chamber of Deputies in Brazilian history, according to results from Brazil's Superior Electoral Court.”.
